deterministic_policy.initial_state: Actual last chronological accepted N9 full field; all 22 frozen original inputs and original N9 export manifest are byte-bound. No virtual or rejected field is promoted.
deterministic_policy.target: largest current original probe0 float64 absolute residual; first original free index on ties
deterministic_policy.virtual_order: First radius 1,2,4,8; within each radius ascending original CSC target-row columns, direction -1 then +1, one coordinate. Then radius 1,2,4,8; within each radius ascending target-row columns except target, direction -1 then +1 for secondary; primary is target diagonal coordinate one ULP opposite signed original native residual.
deterministic_policy.virtual_steps: Bind an intent to current full-field SHA before arithmetic. Reproduce original CSC-order target float64 residual and exact target values; if target passes, predict every row in the complete nonzero union of changed original columns. Require predicted original five maximum nonincrease and strictly fewer violating probe0 rows. Then evaluate exact complete affected union and certified unchanged anchor. All completed screens and every started intent are preserved, including ineligible screens.
deterministic_policy.outside_float64_max_proof: At most 512 affected rows. Of 513 largest current absolute native residual rows at least one is outside; their maximum outside the union is the exact maximum over every unaffected row, with ties harmless. Actual full native residual bytes must equal the resulting full prediction.
deterministic_policy.virtual_float64_order: explicit Python float multiplication followed by float addition in ascending original CSC column order; every cached baseline row must match actual current native CSC residual bits; no compensated summation and no replacement of the native gate
deterministic_policy.full_candidate: the first current eligible virtual screen, counted and reported before construction; actual original-domain fields, requested and actual updates, all five native gates, longdouble diagnostic only, and complete proofs
accept_only_if: A proof of full mathematical residual infinity nonincrease: affected exact max nonincreasing OR a current exact anchor outside the complete changed-column nonzero support with absolute residual >= affected exact after maximum.
probe0 over-gate row count strictly decreases
maximum original float64 ratio over full five does not increase
four prior passing fields and residuals remain exact array/file bytes and passing native gates
actual complete native probe0 residual bytes and gate/count equal the finite all-affected prediction
deterministic_policy.global_mathematical_proof: Every exact equation outside the union of all changed nonzero original column supports is unchanged. New affected maximum is bounded either by the old affected maximum or by a directly verified current exact anchor outside the union. Therefore global mathematical residual infinity cannot increase.
deterministic_policy.anchor_order: Directly sum seed original DOF59009 in every current stage. If outside union and sufficient use it; otherwise choose the largest absolute exact known current cached row outside union, first original DOF on ties. Reader independently recreates all virtual cache additions and directly sums selected anchor before and after each actual full field.
deterministic_policy.all_native_attempts_bound_proof: Initial 15 violating rows. Every accepted trial strictly decreases this integer. All attempts are counted before execution. Any unaccepted trial or mismatch is terminal. First all-five pass stops. Thus at most 15 attempts total, including one possible terminal rejection; this is enforced in addition to unchanged original 96 cap.
deterministic_policy.termination: first accepted all-five pass, first actual full mismatch or rejection, current target finite exhaustion, derived all-attempt count bound, or original/explicit finite resource cap; final state is the chronological accepted state and never historical best

finite_search_and_cache.cache_invalidation: After accepted state, discard stage row and exact cache; reconstruct directly from next actual field. Global work counters never reset.

time_basis.virtual_projection_formula: 2*(6.466818889-3.909810624)*max(8192/904,96000000/7391208,2000000/140520,1000000/95283). The factor two covers observed Python/NumPy row access and accounting differences; this remains a representative estimate, not a worst-case guarantee.
time_basis.worker_planning_formula: 15*max(N9 complete five-gate trial time)+N9 baseline/final+N9 setup+virtual work projection+20 seconds bookkeeping and field/reference margin
time_basis.reader_planning_formula: 85*(N9 entire reader time/20 native gates)+virtual work projection+original 2M direct exact sample projection+20 seconds bookkeeping margin; baseline and setup are partly counted again
time_basis.actual_authority: unchanged original supervisor and guards; any actual cap, mismatch, failure or partial field is retained
